question: How does manifesting all as one's own self reveal the source of arising and dissolution?
premises: Being is manifested as the self of all.
This existence is identified as such.
It is the source of both arising and non-existence.
inference: Realizing all being as one's own self reveals the principle that is the origin and dissolution of existence.
plain_english: Manifesting being through the nature of being the self of all, this existence is the source of arising and dissolution.
